extracted.intended_audience: legal researchers, attorneys, agency staff, and members of the public who access or cite the Pennsylvania Code and Pennsylvania Bulletin
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for accessing, citing, and using material from the Pennsylvania Code and the Pennsylvania Bulletin (the Commonwealth’s official publications of rules, regulations, and rulemaking notices). Includes citation format examples, publication/timeliness notes, and usage/terms of use guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation format for Pennsylvania Code
rubrics_metrics.description: Cite all material in the Pennsylvania Code by title number and section number. Example: 1 Pa. Code § 17.51.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the title number and section number format exactly as shown; include the section symbol (§) and the 'Pa. Code' short form when citing. This entry is the site’s explicit instruction for legal citation of Code material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation format for Pennsylvania Bulletin
rubrics_metrics.description: Cite all material in the Pennsylvania Bulletin by volume and page number. Example: 17 Pa.B. 639.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When citing Bulletin notices or rulemaking, use the volume and page number format with the 'Pa.B.' abbreviation. Follow this format for references in legal documents and public comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness / access schedule for latest Bulletin information
rubrics_metrics.description: The latest published information may be accessed every Friday at 9 a.m. EDT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users who need the most recent rulemaking or notices should check the Bulletin at or after this weekly publication time. This is the site’s stated schedule for when new Bulletin content is available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provenance and authority of the site content
rubrics_metrics.description: The information for the Pennsylvania Code included at this website has been derived directly from the Pennsylvania Code, the Commonwealth's official publication of rules and regulations. The information for the Pennsylvania Bulletin included at this website has been derived directly from the Pennsylvania Bulletin, the Commonwealth’s official gazette for information and rulemaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material on the site is presented as derived from the official Commonwealth publications; cite primary sources (Pa. Code / Pa.B.) as authoritative. The site is published and distributed by Fry Communications, Inc. in cooperation with the Legislative Reference Bureau under the policy, supervision and direction of the Joint Committee on Documents (provenance statement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on reproduction for profit
rubrics_metrics.description: No part of the information on this website may be reproduced for profit or sold for profit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site’s terms of use prohibit commercial resale or profitable reproduction of the site’s content. For redistribution or commercial use, seek permission per the site's terms (see Disclaimer and Terms of Use links).

rubrics_metrics.name: Questions about a regulation or notice directed to promulgating agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions regarding a regulation or notice should be directed to the promulgating agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site does not handle substantive agency inquiries; users seeking clarification about a rule or notice must contact the agency that issued the regulation/notice (contact information will typically be in the agency’s entry in the Bulletin).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow site Style Manual and publication schedules
rubrics_metrics.description: Style Manual; Code Publication Schedule; Bulletin Publication Schedule (links presented on the site).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides a Style Manual and publication schedules (linked) which contain further formatting, editorial, and scheduling rules for the Code/Bulletin. Consult those documents for detailed requirements on formatting, editorial conventions, and publication timing.
